_note: How a team run's budget is split (BudgetPolicy in core/team/config.py, which documents each field). All values except expected_output_tokens_per_operator are placeholders, not measured, to be tuned on the dev incidents. Shares are decimal strings. director_share stays free in the run for the director's diagnosis and its one repair; auditor_share is the auditor's allocation; the rest goes to the blocks by max-min fairness over their estimated need, smallest first, each allocated just before it runs so unspent money rolls forward; expected_output_tokens_per_operator (1889) sizes that need and is measured on the smoke bundle only: the mean operator output of the second smoke record run (runs/cassettes/team_smoke.run2.json), not of inc-01 operators, which have not run live yet; a manager keeps manager_share of its block and the rest is its operators' pool. A task may spend at most task_limit_first_rung_reservations times its first reservation plus task_limit_next_rung_reservations times that request's reservation one rung up the model ladder, so a reassignment one rung up can fit. manager_max_input_tokens (a placeholder) is the estimated input above which a manager consolidates its findings in batches.
